text:
emma_finance: FYI Medivance flagged their renewal invoice (private deploy). They say platform fee was charged twice (annual + proration) and support was auto-upgraded to Premium without a signed amendment. Procurement is pushing back.

ryan_account_manager: Which invoice number?

emma_finance: Invoice 71234. Lines look like: 
```
- Private license (annual): $220,000
- Platform fee (annual): $30,000
- Platform fee (prorated migration): $15,000
- Support (auto-upgrade to Premium prorated): $9,000
- True-up adjustment (reserved vCPU change): $12,000
Balance: $286,000
```

olga_revops: I pulled the seat/sku history. Medivance moved from Dedicated-L to Dedicated-XL mid-contract (resizing request) which triggered a platform proration. But I also see an annual platform fee on the renewal, so looks like both proration and full fee were billed.

lex_billing: NetSuite shows two platform fee charge lines linked to different transactions: one renewal invoice and one adjustment. It appears billing didn't net the adjustment against renewal. No credit memo yet.

ops-bot: System: capacity resize event 2025-11-12T04:08Z. old_pool=D-L, new_pool=D-XL, change requested by account-team request-id: resize-medivance-20251112.

support_agent: Customer message: "Your portal shows we were moved to Premium support without our consent. We never signed a new SOW."

emma_finance: We need to be careful: reversing platform fees may impact revenue recognition. Also auto-applying Premium support without contract is risky. Propose: (a) issue a corrective credit memo for the duplicate platform fee ($15,000) if ops confirms the resize triggered an adjustment that should have offset the renewal line, (b) remove Premium support charge until we have a signed amendment, and (c) hold true-up until we reconcile usage logs. All contingent on approvals.

ryan_account_manager: Sales didn't request an upgrade. That must be an automated rule in the console that promoted customers above a threshold. I asked product for the rule id last week. I'll confirm with the account owner.

olga_revops: To reconcile: I can produce a timeline and a CSV of SKU events and attach to Zendesk ticket FIN-2619. That will show whether the prorate was intended to offset renewal.

lex_billing: If Finance approves corrective actions, billing will create: (1) credit memo $15,000 (GL 4202) for duplicate platform fee, (2) debit reversal for Premium support $9,000, and (3) put the true-up $12,000 on hold pending usage reconciliation. Need explicit finance approval and ops artifact.

emma_finance: Approve conditional on RevOps timeline + ops-bot logs + support transcript. Also require note from legal confirming no unauthorized SOW change. Legal, can you confirm if we can reverse support charges before signed amendment?

legal_bot: Auto-check: standard T&Cs require signed amendment for support tier changes. Finance may reverse charges and flag for recovery, but document actions in ticket for audit.

ryan_account_manager: I'll get an internal confirmation that sales did not approve upgrade. If it was system-triggered, product needs to revert automation and notify customers. I'll update within 24h.

olga_revops: Uploading timeline + SKU CSV to FIN-2619 now. Attaching ops-bot event and resize request.

lex_billing: Once FIN-2619 has artifacts and legal sign-off, billing will post credit memo $15,000 and reverse the $9,000 support prorate. We'll also create a memo: "Duplicate platform fee due to billing offset error during capacity resize; Premium support charge reversed pending signed amendment."

emma_finance: Approved on those conditions. One more thing: to avoid repeat, RevOps & Billing should coordinate on a rule: any capacity adjustment within 30 days of renewal should auto-hold proration until manual review. Can we implement that as a temporary control?

olga_revops: Agree. I'll propose a 30-day hold rule in the next Ops weekly and loop in billing/product.

ryan_account_manager: I'll notify Medivance procurement that we're investigating and that charges will be corrected if our reconciliation confirms the error. Keeping them on a soft hold.

lex_billing: Action items summarized: (1) Wait for FIN-2619 artifacts & legal note; (2) Post credit memo $15,000 and support reversal $9,000 once present; (3) Put true-up $12,000 on pending status; (4) Link all items to invoice 71234 in NetSuite.

emma_finance: Good. Marking this thread pending artifacts. Tagging @olga_revops @lex_billing @ryan_account_manager. :white_check_mark:

(End of thread)
